sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 140. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 50. Heals HP.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 40 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases fire elemental attack for all allies by 4 for 90 seconds.
Only [Five Sacred Beasts] Suzaku can be used as Unlocking Potential material
